summary: Authenticated BTC/USD evidence identified a completed 08:00 UTC Bybit spot turnover outlier (volume robust z +6.3878 against 28 prior completed hours) without price-range expansion and without confirmation from Bybit linear volume. Three BTC price representations showed ordinary range. A point-in-time spot spread was recorded without persistence claims. Licensed NQ/GC/SI aggregates lagged to 01:00 UTC and were excluded from contemporaneous corroboration. The result is an isolated spot-turnover anomaly, not a broad volatility, liquidity, or directional-order-flow shock.
